# arrowheadr

## Purpose

The arrowheadr package allows one to create custom arrowheads that can
be used with the [ggarrow](https://github.com/teunbrand/ggarrow)
package.

## Installation

The arrowheadr package can be installed via CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("arrowheadr")
```

The development version of arrowheadr can be installed by running this
code:

``` r

install.packages("arrowheadr", repos = c('https://wjschne.r-universe.dev'))
```

# Example

The ggarrow package makes it possible to create a wide variety of
arrows. The arrowheadr package makes it easy to create custom
arrowheads.

``` r

tibble(
  theta = seq(0, 300, 60) * pi / 180,
  x = cos(theta),
  y = sin(theta)
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x, y)) +
  coord_equal() +
  geom_arrow_segment(aes(
    xend = x,
    yend = y,
    x = 0,
    y = 0
  ),
  arrow_head = arrow_head_deltoid(),
  resect = 2)
```

![Arrows pointing outward from a common
point](reference/figures/README-fig-arrow-1.png)

Figure 1: Using arrowheadr with ggarrow

The ggdiagram package also uses arrowheadr and ggarrow under the hood.

``` r

# Make a circle
A <- ob_circle(center = ob_point(0, 0), radius = 1)

# Make angles evenly spaced around a circle
theta <- degree(seq(0, 330, 30))

# Make ring of points around the circle
p <- ob_point() |>
  place(from = A, where = theta, sep = 2)

# Make rotated squares
B <- ob_rectangle(center = p, angle = theta)


ggdiagram() +
  A +
  B +
  # Arrows from A to B
  connect(A, 
          B, 
          resect = 2) +
  # Straight arrows from B to adjacent B
  connect(B@north, 
          B[c(2:12, 1)]@south, 
          resect = 2) +
  # Arc arrows from B to adjacent B
  connect(B[c(2:12, 1)]@east, 
          B@east, 
          arc_bend = -1, 
          resect = 2)
```

![Rectangle arranged in a circle, connected with
arrows](reference/figures/README-fig-ggdiagram-1.png)

Figure 2: Using arrowheadr with ggdiagram

# Package index

## All functions

- [`arrow_head_bezier()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/arrow_head_bezier.md)
  : make arrowhead from list of bezier control points
- [`arrow_head_catenary()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/arrow_head_catenary.md)
  : Make catenary arrowhead
- [`arrow_head_ellipse()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/arrow_head_ellipse.md)
  : Make arrrowhead with ellipse
- [`arrow_head_function()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/arrow_head_function.md)
  : Make arrowheads with any function
- [`arrow_head_harpoon()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/arrow_head_harpoon.md)
  : Make a harpoon arrowhead
- [`arrow_head_hypotrochoid()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/arrow_head_hypotrochoid.md)
  [`arrow_head_deltoid()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/arrow_head_hypotrochoid.md)
  : Make spirograph arrowheads
- [`arrow_head_icon()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/arrow_head_icon.md)
  : Make arrowhead from preset icon
- [`arrow_head_latex()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/arrow_head_latex.md)
  : Make latex arrowhead
- [`arrow_head_reuleaux()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/arrow_head_reuleaux.md)
  : Make reuleaux polygons
- [`arrow_head_trefoil()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/arrow_head_trefoil.md)
  : Make trefoil arrowhead
- [`arrow_head_wittgenstein_rod()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/arrow_head_wittgenstein_rod.md)
  : Make arrowhead with Wittengenstein's Rod
- [`arrowheads`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/arrowheads.md)
  : Arrowheads
- [`nudger()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/nudger.md)
  : Nudge columns of a matrix by fixed amounts
- [`plot_arrowhead()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/plot_arrowhead.md)
  : Plot arrowhead
- [`reflecter()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/reflecter.md)
  : make a reflection of a matrix on the y axis
- [`rescaler()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/rescaler.md)
  : Rescale each column of a matrix
- [`rev_matrix_rows()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/rev_matrix_rows.md)
  [`rev_matrix_cols()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/rev_matrix_rows.md)
  : reverses the order of rows or columns in a matrix
- [`rotater()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/rotater.md)
  : Rotate a 2-column matrix
- [`transformer()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/transformer.md)
  : Do transformations in a desired order
- [`unitizer()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/unitizer.md)
  : Fit matrix to unit circle
- [`v2matrix()`](https://wjschne.github.io/arrowheadr/reference/v2matrix.md)
  : Convert a vector to a matrix
